sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Supraprint24 offers large-format digital printing and fast delivery of advertising products across Europe.

Industry: Printing · Size: not published · Products: PVC Advertising Banners, Mesh Banners, Custom Fabric Banners, Vinyl Stickers, Roll Labels, Custom Stickers

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Supraprint24 scores 33 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (20/30). Nothing was found for company size and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (19% similar on vinyl, printing, advertising, digital); Drytac (10% similar on printed, vinyl, self-adhesive, printing); ORAFOL Europe (10% similar on self-adhesive, printing, digital, graphic). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
